name: RemoveColumnsByMissingRatioNode
label: Remove Columns by Missing Ratio
description: Removes columns whose proportion of missing (null/empty) values exceeds a configurable threshold. The threshold is expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: MaxMissingRatio
fields.label: Max Missing Ratio
fields.description: Columns with a missing-value ratio greater than this threshold are removed. Defaults to 0.8 (removes columns >80% missing).

fields.name: CleanedDataTable
fields.label: Cleaned Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with high-missing columns removed.

fields.name: RemovedColumns
fields.label: Removed Columns
fields.description: A comma-separated list of the names of columns that were removed.
